name: r5-01-fixed
title: Round 5 @ f7c26828: F6, F8 and F5 (text, Write, approval) recover on the real stack
subtitle: Spring + MySQL (Flyway V51 main, V52 main's #13163, V53 this PR) + Hosted Harness + GreenMail + qwen channel managed-email. The Harness is SIGKILLed; the sender writes again at once.

panels.t:
## F8: SIGKILL, mail to an attached thread at once
12:03:29 /inbound  !! 503 (generation mismatch)
12:03:32 /inbound  !! 503 managed_session_writer_conflict × 7
12:04:29 /inbound  ++ 200 admitted (lease lapsed)
++ answered 70 s after the kill
++ 0 emails skipped across every restart on 3 heads
## F6: route Session closed while its reply is held
++ receipt 409 × 2 → "refused (409); it is dropped."
++ Bob's unrelated new thread answered in 7 s

panels.h: F5: text turn and files-profile Write
panels.t:
## text: "HOLD me T#t5" parked at the model
++ Interrupted channel wake turn … was settled without
++ a reply; follow-up answered 70 s after the kill
## Write: worker SIGSTOPped with write_file b.txt in flight
++ load passes the gate once the writer lease lapses
++ the Broker proves the stop; turn settled cancelled
++ follow-up answered 65 s after the kill
++ runtime session RELEASED, Workspace lease freed
++ next model request: dangling tool calls = []

panels.h: F5: approval pending at the crash (1adf5f5b+)
panels.t:
## approval-mode default; write_file waits for approval
++ … keeps its durable wait for its approval; the Session
++ stays usable.
++ allow or deny after the restart → resolve 200
++ … was settled without a reply
++ the model's tool result: "The tool call never ran: the
++ approval ended decided after the Harness that asked
++ was interrupted."
++ follow-up answered (7 s after the decision on r6)
== on 752f9eaf the turn stayed held forever

note: Verified on three successive heads (752f9eaf, 1adf5f5b, f7c26828); every row above was re-run on f7c26828.

name: r5-02-approval-lease-leak
title: New P1 when approvals are enabled: the recovered approval turn never releases the Workspace mount
subtitle: QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_APPROVAL_MODE=default (shipped default: yolo). The turn acquires the Workspace before asking for approval; the crash-recovery settlement does not hand it back.

panels.t:
## write_file n.txt → requested → allow
++ n.txt written, reply sent
++ qwen_runtime_session  chin-d393…  RELEASED
++ managed_workspace_execution_lease  holder = NULL

panels.h: Crash while the approval is pending (r7 @ f7c26828)
panels.t:
12:07:11 Harness SIGKILL, approval tool_approval_f47b… requested
12:08:16 follow-up admitted; allow → turn settled, thread answered
## qwen_runtime_session (12:09:57)
-- chin-1861… (settled approval turn)  READY  since 12:07:10
-- chin-5f61… (another thread)          ACQUIRING since 12:08:44
## managed_workspace_execution_lease
-- holder = chin-1861…  mount_state UNVERIFIED (no expiry)
## Harness
-- … waits for the Workspace mount held by another Session.
-- the other thread: no approval request, no reply
== reproduced 3×: r6 (allow), r6b (deny), r7 (allow)

note: The Write recovery path releases the lease (it stops the runtime through the Broker); the approval path settles the turn without touching the runtime, so its lease outlives it. Every later tool turn of every Session in that Workspace queues behind it.

name: r5-03-shell-unknown
title: Latent (P2): an interrupted shell tool always ends UNKNOWN; its thread stops and its turn keeps the Workspace mount
subtitle: Only reachable with hosted-workspace-shell/1, which Spring never assigns to a workspace Session (ManagedAgentStore.java:422); this rig forces it with a DB trigger.

panels.h: Every real interruption ends UNKNOWN (5 runs)
panels.t:
## shell tool `sleep N` running, Harness SIGKILLed
-- tool finished during the downtime          → unknown
-- no restart: tool reaped 118 s after the kill → unknown
-- fast restart + follow-up at +2 s: tool killed
--   at the takeover (+63 s)                   → unknown
## 752f9eaf: … keeps its durable wait for the recovery fleet
##   then: needs recovery, not a re-drive. (frozen)
## 1adf5f5b+: … defers its recovery to the next wake attempt
##   (retried silently, still 0 replies after 6 min)
== stopParkedRuntimeExecutions throws on 'unknown'; the
== Broker's reconcileExecution is never asked

## qwen_runtime_session
chin-4151… (dead turn)       READY      since 10:53:57
chin-33a0… (other thread)    ACQUIRING  since 11:01:50
chin-ad38… (files-profile    ACQUIRING  write_file)
## managed_workspace_execution_lease
holder = chin-4151…  mount_state = UNVERIFIED (no expiry)
== same Workspace-wide stall as the approval leak

note: Latent today because channel Sessions are files-profile only; it becomes reachable the moment the shell profile is enabled for them.
